question: In 2018, ______ was appointed as UNICEF India's first youth ambassador.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hima Das**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Hima Das is a prominent Indian sprinter known for her achievements in track and field events.
 
• In 2018, she made history by becoming the first Indian athlete to win a gold medal in a track event at the IAAF World U20 Championships.
 
• Hima Das was appointed as UNICEF India’s first youth ambassador in 2018, recognizing her influence and inspiring journey.
 
• She has been an advocate for child rights and has worked to promote education, health, and sports among children in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNICEF (United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund)**

 
 
• UNICEF is a United Nations agency responsible for providing humanitarian and developmental aid to children worldwide.
 
• It was established on December 11, 1946, to provide emergency food and healthcare to children in countries that had been devastated by World War II.
 
• UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential from early childhood through adolescence.
 
• Its programs focus on areas such as child protection, education, immunization, emergency relief, and maternal health.
 
 
 
• **IAAF World U20 Championships**
 
 
• The IAAF World U20 Championships, previously known as the World Junior Championships in Athletics, is a biennial world championships for the sport of athletics organized by the International Association of Athletics Federations (IAAF).
 
• It is a competition for junior athletes (under 20 years of age) and serves as an opportunity to showcase emerging talent on an international stage.
 
• The first edition of the championships was held in Athens, Greece, in 1986.
 
• It includes a wide range of track and field events, including sprints, distance running, jumping, and throwing events.
 
 
 
• **Role of Youth Ambassadors**
 
 
• Youth ambassadors are young leaders who represent and advocate for specific causes, often related to social issues, health, education, and child rights.
 
• They use their influence and platforms to raise awareness, mobilize support, and inspire action among their peers and communities.
 
• As youth ambassadors, individuals like Hima Das work with organizations such as UNICEF to promote positive change and development.
 
• Their involvement helps to bridge the gap between young people and decision-makers, ensuring that the voices of the youth are heard and considered in policy-making processes.
